hero_headline: A warmer first impression for grooming appointments
hero_subheadline: A pet-care homepage concept built around comfort, grooming services, proof, location, and a simple appointment path.
current_site_snapshot: The appointment path can feel more confident if grooming proof, comfort cues, and location details are closer to the first screen.
visual_direction: Warm, trustworthy, friendly pet-care layout with happy-pet proof and clear appointment flow.
photo_strategy: Use real groomed-pet photos where available; fallback visuals must read as concept imagery.

visual_profile.photo_strategy: Happy-pet hero plus grooming service proof cards.
visual_profile.ui_personality: soft proof cards, appointment-first flow, friendly trust badges
visual_profile.trust_style: comfort cues before the appointment CTA

media_assets.usage_note: Fallback concept visual only; replace with public grooming photos when available.

website_issue_examples: Comfort cues are not prominent before booking
Appointment path can be clearer on mobile
Proof photos should sit closer to services
cta_strategy: Choose grooming service -> Review comfort cues -> Book appointment
content_strategy_angle: Finished groom photos, comfort process clips, appointment reminders
meta_ads_angle: Local proof content boosted to pet owners near the shop
email_body:
Hi Jennifer's Pet Grooming team,

I noticed the appointment path could use more grooming proof and comfort cues near the first screen.
